source.citation: James Otto Lewis, CHA-CO-TO, A Pottowattomie Chief, from The Aboriginal Port Folio, 1835, hand-coloured lithograph (Lehman & Duval, Philadelphia), after a sketch inscribed 'Taken at the Treaty of Massinnewa, Indiana by J. O. Lewis 1827'. Smithsonian American Art Museum 1973.167.3.
what_it_does_not_supply: everyday dress: it was taken at a treaty, with paint and feathers that the 14 August figure does not wear
what_it_supplies: a Potawatomi man of the 1820s drawn from life: shirt, blanket worn over the shoulders, a cloth head wrap
